note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide is written in our own words for this entry and names its sources; no guide text is copied from another guide. Counts are stated only where the official description states them.

roadmap.note: Play the story straight through. Watch the two missable flags here: leave VCIA your own way for Catch Me If You Can, and choose deliberately for Actions Speak Louder.
roadmap.title: Story — Chapters 1–4 & the finale

roadmap.note: Finish every stranger strand and every side-character finale — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — plus 8 stranger strands for the silver.
roadmap.title: Strangers & side characters

roadmap.note: The long sweep: meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK photos, 100 vehicles, every named area and every garage. Region by region, with the community maps.
roadmap.title: Collectibles — see all of Leonida

roadmap.note: Races, the range, fishing, the arcade, bowling and the Scooter Bros app. Gold all 42 range challenges for The Shootist, and win 20 different races.
roadmap.title: Activities & challenges

roadmap.note: Robberies, wanted levels and the two remaining missables — Bad Luck, I Guess and The Truth Is Out There. Launder $250,000 and spend $100,000 along the way.
roadmap.title: Mayhem & money

roadmap.note: Check the stats page: when 100% completion pops, the platinum follows. Anything left is a sweep of the stages above.
roadmap.title: 100% & the platinum

trophies.guide: This is the reward for the other 54. Follow the roadmap in order — story, strangers, collectibles, activities, then mayhem — and let the tracker show what is left. The header's grade breakdown shows your earned count per grade, so the last few trophies are easy to spot. Nothing here needs a second playthrough if you sweep the missable flags on the first one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn, and it cannot be missed — if you have started the story, it is only a matter of finishing the mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Chapter trophies unlock when the chapter's last mission ends, so there is no separate task — keep playing the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks at the end of the chapter's final mission; no side task is needed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. Story only — play the chapter's missions to the end and the trophy pops at the last one.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full, the last story chapter before the finale. Play its missions through to the end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the gold story trophy: finish the finale and it unlocks with the end of the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop when the mission ends — play it through; replaying a mission from the menu still counts if you ever need it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission — follow the objectives to the end and the trophy pops at the results screen.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play it through to the end; the trophy unlocks when the mission does.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story only — finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown — the airport mission. Finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play it through to the end like any other mission trophy.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game stats page tracks it — story missions, strangers, collectibles, activities and challenges all feed the percentage. Use the tracker here to sweep each category, then check the stats page for the last few points. This is the second gold and the last step before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total, and the game tracks it in stats. Chain them in free roam: a fast car, a long straight and a jump ramp will stack them quickly. It is a grind, not a skill gate — keep at it and the count climbs.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, bowling, drone races, meditation and challenges. Dip into each one; you only need one attempt at each, not a win.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the range's courses — learn each course's targets, then chase gold one at a time; the range tracks your best medal per challenge. Community guides list the course layouts — see Exophase and PSNProfiles for the per-challenge breakdown.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Each location hosts its own race; win each one once. If a race gives you trouble, retry it from the start — wins are tracked per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — street, off-road, boat or air — as long as each win is a race you have not won before. Vary your picks and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots and take the challenge — out-fish him and the trophy pops. Fishing is timing-based: watch the line tension and reel when the fish runs.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish one full game at any arcade cabinet. Pick a short one and play it to the end; you do not need a high score.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand in order; the trophy pops when his last mission ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern — finish Kenton's strand to its last mission and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand; the trophy unlocks at his last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map — take each strand to its end. Eight finished strands earns the silver; the tracker shows which strangers you have done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet viewpoints marked in the world; sit and meditate at each one. Community maps list them all — see Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at a one-of-a-kind animal — track it, take the shot and the trophy is yours. It is a story strand, so it cannot be missed once you start Bret's missions.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — each set needs its full run of cards. Collectors' maps on Exophase and PSNProfiles show every card location; finish any three sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK photo spots are scattered across the state — open the camera at each marked spot and snap it. 100 is a long sweep, so work region by region and use the community map on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks everywhere — stunts, races, combat and exploration all feed them. Play widely and the count climbs; check stats to see which categories lag.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get the heat to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search until it drops. A quiet stretch of countryside helps — lose the cops, don't fight them.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner alongside, keeping at least one star the whole time — don't let the heat drop between robberies. Plan a route past three close shops and move fast.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. 'Discover' means getting in and driving a vehicle you have not driven before — the game logs each new model. Variety is the trick: try everything from scooters to trucks, and the count climbs as you explore.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of five or more, trigger Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends. A crowded street fight or a gang hideout gives you the numbers — line the shots up first, then trigger it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is tied to the airport story sequence — when the mission gives you the chance to leave the airport your own way, take it instead of following the marked exit. MISSABLE: if you leave by the scripted route, the moment is gone for this playthrough.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks — get in one, or take the heat in one, and the trophy pops. Steal one from a military convoy or a base and go for a drive.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses calling it in. Plan the entry, move when the clerk looks away and get out before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, five clean getaways — each one needs the escape as well as the robbery, so plan the exit before you go in. The silver is for doing all five.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat — the escape counts as much as the robbery.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each named area; the counter is in the stats page. Drive the whole state and the last area pops the trophy.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs its own illegal operations; hit one per gang. Gang territory maps on Exophase and PSNProfiles show where each gang operates.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy, no combat needed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a showroom's front — the old-school exit. Any showroom works; pick your car and go.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling at that alley — finish all frames and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one comes from a partner story moment — play the partner missions and it unlocks at the scene the description points to.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Some story choices are tracked — the game remembers them. MISSABLE: choices lock in when made, so on a first playthrough pick deliberately and keep a save from before the big decisions if you want to sweep them all.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This pops on a second attempt at a one-off moment — if it doesn't come the first time, the retry is the point. MISSABLE: tied to a single scripted moment, so don't reload past it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange one-off event out in the world — the kind you stumble on while exploring. MISSABLE: random encounters like this may not repeat, so check the community reports on Exophase and PSNProfiles for where it was seen.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, swing a melee weapon at a pedestrian and knock them down — a drive-by with a bat, not a gun. A quiet street and a slow car make it easy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts to clean them. It is a slow total, so keep laundering after every big job and the $250,000 arrives on its own.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, food, weapons, car mods — every shop purchase counts toward the total. Spend as you play and it climbs; the counter is in stats.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages go on sale across Leonida; buy each one. They also give you somewhere to store the 100 vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register a vehicle you own or drive, and repeat ten times — any ten vehicles count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
